_comment: Travelers Companies FY2025 (data/edgar/TRV.json) plus illustrative market inputs (risk-free = 10yr UST, ERP = Damodaran implied ERP, beta = illustrative for a large-cap P&C insurer -- moderate, since insurance demand is fairly non-cyclical even though earnings/book value are catastrophe- and rate-exposed). Cost of equity (CAPM) is what feeds the residual-income valuation, same convention as examples/wacc_usb.json -- debt=0 is a deliberate simplification: an insurer's real capital base is policyholder surplus (equity), not the modest holdco debt on its balance sheet, and residual income only needs cost of equity.
